status: prospective execution-method amendment before new scientific predictions
scope: Local Docker execution of the unchanged frozen main and laboratory studies
reason: The selected local Docker host has a systemd cgroup driver but no unattended host systemctl authorization. Docker creates a uniquely owned parent; a helper configures only that exact parent.
unchanged: All frozen cases, source/input/reference/model bytes, eight arm settings, request order/seeds, first-attempt and scoring rules.
One or two total CPUs, fixed affinity per profile, 3GiB aggregate memory, zero swap, serial arms and complete cgroup accounting.
All six exact candidates must pass signature, attestation, source and executed-image identity admission before scientific execution.
accounting: An idle sentinel stays alive throughout each arm so systemd cannot reset the parent quota between sibling container starts. Its resource use is inside the stated application budget.
CPU counters retain a setup baseline; timed-request CPU differences exclude earlier setup.
Parent lifetime memory.peak includes bootstrap and sentinel overhead. No unsupported peak reset or cold-storage claim.
The helper mounts only the uniquely owned cgroup; no host control socket, host PID namespace or privileged container is required.
interpretation: Report this local method, full hardware/affinity/cgroup limits and competing host activity; do not pool these measurements with historical hosted results.
